common_contract.capacity: 1024 bytes per direction with 256 release and 128 control reserved
common_contract.clock: immutable acquisition epoch; actual arrival; lag-6 usefulness; TTL-24 archive deadline
common_contract.denominators: all generated records retained; timely, late, rejected, selected and origin-verified are distinct

centralized_v6_reference.selection: all timely direct arrivals; downstream estimator must use the common processing budget
exclusions: no external model weights or feature pipeline

privacy_only_v6_reference.selection: no raw estimator input; transport accepts only caller-created protected releases
exclusions: no private task-allocation or truth-discovery reproduction

blockchain_dt_v6_reference.selection: audit-admitted timely direct arrivals; signed inclusion required before allocation
exclusions: no BFT, finality, availability or censorship-resistance claim

opportunistic_ttl_v6_reference.selection: all timely arrivals after bounded-copy deadline-priority forwarding
exclusions: not a reproduction of Hernandez-Orallo et al.
no external utility or diffusion-learning logic
